sentence_map.target: Let $q_{\rm tr}$ denote the prior distribution of $H_k$ represented by the channel samples used for training.
sentence_map.note: 保留训练先验定义；本次未定位完整原句。

sentence_map.target: In this paper, we aim to simultaneously detect the active devices and estimate the corresponding channels based on the observation $\mathbf Y$ under a Bayesian inference framework \cite{cai2026}.

source.original: In this paper, we aim to simultaneously detect the active devices and estimate the corresponding channels based on the observation Y under a Bayesian inference framework.

sentence_map.note: 完整原句。

sentence_map.target: Exact Bayesian estimators, e.g., the MMSE estimator, are generally intractable due to the high-dimensional integrals in the marginalization of the joint posterior distribution $q(\mathbf X,\{H_k\}_{k=1}^{K},\{\alpha_k\}_{k=1}^{K}\mid\mathbf Y)$.

source.original: Exact Bayesian estimators, e.g., the MMSE estimator, are generally intractable due to the high-dimensional integrals in the marginalization of the joint posterior distribution p(X,{H_k}_{k=1}^{K},{alpha_k}_{k=1}^{K}|Y).

sentence_map.note: 补回原句末完整联合后验；q为本文工作后验，非真实后验的同义名。

sentence_map.target: Alternatively, message-passing algorithms provide a low-complexity iterative approach for approximately calculating the MMSE estimator \cite{cai2026}.

source.original: Alternatively, message-passing algorithms [5], [6], [27], [47] provide a low-complexity iterative approach for approximately calculating the MMSE estimator.

sentence_map.note: 完整原句；引文显示归并至Cai。

sentence_map.target: In message passing, we factorize the joint posterior distribution according to Bayes' theorem and the conditional independence relationships among the variables, expressed as \begin{equation} \begin{aligned} &q(\mathbf X,\{H_k\}_{k=1}^{K},\{\alpha_k\}_{k=1}^{K}\mid\mathbf Y)\\ &\quad\propto\prod_{j=1}^{MN}p(\mathbf y_j\mid\mathbf x_j)\\ &\qquad\times\prod_{k=1}^{K} p(X_k\mid H_k,\alpha_k)q_{\rm tr}(H_k)p(\alpha_k), \end{aligned} \label{eq:working-posterior} \end{equation} where $\mathbf x_j\in\mathbb C^{KN}$ and $\mathbf y_j\in\mathbb C^Q$ denote the $j$-th column of $\mathbf X=[\mathbf x_1,\ldots,\mathbf x_{MN}]$ and $\mathbf Y=[\mathbf y_1,\ldots,\mathbf y_{MN}]$, respectively.

source.original: In message passing, we factorize the joint posterior distribution according to Baye’s theorem and the conditional independence relationships among the variables, expressed as p(X,{H_k}_{k=1}^{K},{alpha_k}_{k=1}^{K}|Y) ∝ [product_{m=1}^{M} p(y_m|x_m)] [product_{k=1}^{K} p(X_k|H_k,alpha_k)p(H_k)p(alpha_k)], where x_m in C^{NK} and y_m in C^{NT} denote the m-th column of X=[x_1,...,x_M] and Y=[y_1,...,y_M], respectively.

sentence_map.note: 恢复完整where并按本文维度定义列；唯一非术语文字例外是Bayes拼写纠错。显示式已独立检查，不能当作Cai原模型。

sentence_map.target: Here, $q$ is the working posterior, $p(\mathbf y_j\mid\mathbf x_j)=\CN(\mathbf y_j; \widehat{\mathbf A}\mathbf x_j,\widehat\sigma^2\I_Q)$ is the Gaussian likelihood from \eqref{eq:mmv}, $p(X_k\mid H_k,\alpha_k)$ imposes $X_k=\alpha_kH_k$, and $p(\alpha_k)=\rho^{\alpha_k}(1-\rho)^{1-\alpha_k}$.
sentence_map.note: 本文完整模型定义：固定前端估计下的高斯似然、X=alpha H约束、Bernoulli先验与工作后验q。Cai表II提供相关数学对象而非此完整原句。

sentence_map.target: The MMSE channel estimate and posterior probability of activity can be calculated as \begin{equation} \begin{aligned} X_k^{\rm MMSE}&=\E_q[X_k\mid\mathbf Y],\\ p_k^{\rm Bayes}&=q(\alpha_k=1\mid\mathbf Y). \end{aligned} \label{eq:targets} \end{equation}
sentence_map.note: 保留MMSE X及活动后验概率两个目标；本次未定位完整原句。

sentence_map.target: The main difficulty in implementing message passing on the factor graph lies in the message calculation associated with the factor node $q_{\rm tr}(H_k)$, detailed as follows \cite{cai2026}.

source.original: The main difficulty in implementing message passing on the factor graph lies in the message calculation associated with the factor node p(H_k), detailed as follows.

sentence_map.note: 恢复detailed as follows并补回两个条目。

sentence_map.target: It is extremely challenging, if not impossible, to obtain an accurate characterization of the channel distribution $p(H_k)$.

source.original: It is extremely challenging, if not impossible, to obtain an accurate characterization of the channel distribution p(H_k).

sentence_map.note: p(H_k)明确保留为真实分布；不改成q_tr，也不称其等价。

sentence_map.target: Existing literature resorts to various assumptions, e.g., Rayleigh fading, Rician fading, angular-frequency structured sparsity, or frequency-domain block-wise linearity, to model the wireless channel \cite{cai2026}.

source.original: Existing literature resorts to various assumptions, e.g., Rayleigh fading [5], [6], Rician fading [10], angular-frequency structured sparsity [11], or frequency-domain block-wise linearity [27], to model the wireless channel.

sentence_map.note: 完整句；Cai原句的分项文献标记归并为Cai，属于引文显示变化；这是二手来源归属，不声称独立核验全部原始文献。

sentence_map.target: These assumptions, however, may be mismatched with the ground-truth prior distribution, leading to significant performance degradation and potentially causing the algorithm to diverge.

source.original: These assumptions, however, may be mismatched with the ground-truth prior distribution, leading to significant performance degradation and potentially causing the algorithm to diverge.

sentence_map.note: 完整原句；前句assumptions恢复，指代完整。

sentence_map.target: The messages associated with the factor node $q_{\rm tr}(H_k)$ can only be derived under specific, simple, and easily computable priors.

source.original: The messages associated with the factor node p(H_k) can only be derived under specific, simple, and easily computable priors.

sentence_map.note: 完整原句；依来源上下文指解析消息计算，不宣称数值积分不可能。

sentence_map.target: For example, the work in \cite{ke2020} adopted a simple i.i.d.\ Bernoulli-Gaussian distribution to account for the inherent sparsity in the angular domain.

source.original: For example, the work in [11] adopted a simple i.i.d. Bernoulli-Gaussian distribution to account for the inherent sparsity in the angular domain.

sentence_map.target: Generally speaking, even if the training channel distribution becomes analytically available, calculating the messages for the factor node $q_{\rm tr}(H_k)$ remains highly challenging due to the complicated and high-dimensional integrals (as will be discussed in Section~\ref{sec:algorithm}).

source.original: Generally speaking, even if the ground-truth channel distribution becomes analytically available, calculating the messages for the factor node p(H_k) remains highly challenging due to the complicated and high-dimensional integrals (as will be discussed in Section III-B).

sentence_map.target: To summarize, the message-passing framework faces a dilemma: the adopted channel prior is either too imprecise to ensure good performance, or too complex to facilitate efficient message calculation.

source.original: To summarize, the message-passing framework faces a dilemma: the adopted channel prior is either too imprecise to ensure good performance, or too complex to facilitate efficient message calculation.

sentence_map.note: 完整原句；两个困难条目已恢复。
